race.description: 2026 Psp Peak Of The Creek Heat 2
race.comment: SWEET ROCKY (4) started favourite but had to work so wasn't disgraced when fifth last week. Had a series of decent efforts prior including a win from a wider barrier at this circuit and distance. Good enough to take out a race like this. BITE THE EAR MIKE (7) draws wide but his consistency is hard to knock, putting a string of top-four results together. KEAYANG SEASIDE (1) flies fresh with two wins and a placing from three attempts and should get every chance from a favourable draw. MISTER MANAGER (9) can feature with even luck from a back row draw.
